full_name: Nathalie Peutz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Rita E. Hauser Fellow New York University Abu Dhabi (United Arab Emirates)
bio: Nathalie Peutz is a cultural anthropologist whose research examines the impacts of conflict-induced displacement, the climate crisis, social marginalization, and racial borders in the Western Indian Ocean region. At Radcliffe, she will write an ethnography based on her research at a Yemeni refugee camp in Djibouti, exploring the effects on refugees in the Global South of the UN’s Global Compact on Refugees.
